title: Thomas Thwaites: How I built a toaster -- from scratch
summary: Designer Thomas Thwaites describes his attempt to build a toaster from scratch, from mining ore and deriving plastic from oil. It is a short TED talk on how much civilization a simple object depends on.
why: HN uses it as the standard illustration of hidden complexity and supply-chain dependencies behind everyday objects.
